guide: GPUI Kit Design Guides 944803984cf0 (design-guides.md): design review + accessibility checklists, Interaction states, Feedback and overlays, Data-heavy interfaces, Interface language
method: Live list and dialogs reviewed on the real retained service (GET only; every non-GET aborted by the harness, none attempted). The live store has no changes, so detail/diff/panels were verified through the real shell with the real ui.js/icons.js/code-review.js and fixture JSON answering only /api/code-review* (/tmp/kiln-review-fixture.json). Dialogs opened then cancelled.
web_deviations: Header slot #page-primary-action keeps a primary button ('Create change…'): kiln.web.visual_design requires one primary action per view (parent decision), although the guide makes a command that only opens a form a default Button. Inside dialogs primary stays on the commit.
Navigation to console routes (change titles, revisions, file rows, line permalinks, thread links, 'All changes') stays links.

findings: BUG: every review dialog failed to open: icon-only buttons asked for Lucide 'close', which is not in icons.list ('Unknown icon: close' in the status notice). Affected Create change, contribution, confirmations, saved-view delete and reviewer removal.
Header commands that open a form had no ellipsis ('Create change', 'Submit contribution branch').
Lexicon: 'Submit contribution branch' reused 'Submit', which elsewhere means submitting a change to its target.
Access state rendered as a success-toned status pill (access is a classification, not an outcome), with no gap before 'as <principal>'.
Unread notifications marked by a leading info-coloured bar.
Disclosures ('Save current query as a personal view', exact identities, editors) had no visible disclosure affordance.
Change table cells were middle-aligned, so column first lines did not share a spine.
State filter options were lowercase canonical values.
fixes: Icon-only buttons take icon("x") (now also visible to the reviewed-icon test regex).
'Create change…' and 'Contribute branch…' (docs/operator.md updated).
Access is a neutral chip with shield-check/eye icon and flex gap.
Unread uses weight plus the existing 'Unread' text; no edge bar.
Disclosures use KilnUi.disclosureSummary (rotating chevron).
Table cells top-aligned; filter options sentence case.

findings: Overlay stacking: the form dialog stayed open beneath its confirmation.
Titles were long phrases; commit labels ('Register change', 'Confirm branch intake') did not match the opening command, and lacked an ellipsis although they lead to a confirmation.
Body copy said 'Upload registers…' in a Create dialog.
fixes: modal() hides the covered dialog while a confirmation is open and reopens it on dismissal; Escape/Cancel return focus to the trigger (verified: confirmation → form → header button).
Titles 'Create change' / 'Contribute branch for review'; commits 'Create change…' / 'Contribute branch…'; body rewritten.

findings: Every confirmation used a generic title and a 'Confirm <title lowercased>' button (for example 'Confirm register change'), plus a ritual 'Confirm these exact values…' sentence.
Destructive confirmations (dequeue, delete view, delete draft, abandon) used primary styling.
fixes: confirmAction({ title, verb, facts, dismiss, danger }): title names verb and object, commit repeats the verb, dismissal keeps the state; role=alertdialog; focus starts on the dismissal; danger styling for destructive results. Exact fact rows unchanged.

Copy: Create change "<title>"? / Create change; Contribute branch "<ref>" for review? / Contribute branch; Cancel merge queue entry for "<title>"? / Cancel queue entry / Keep queued; Authorize merge automation for "<title>"? / Authorize automation; Submit "<title>" to <target>? / Submit change (also each ordered-stack step); Apply N suggestion(s) to "<title>"?; Delete personal view "<name>"? / Delete view; Delete private draft on <file:range>? / Delete draft; Publish review on "<title>"? / Publish review; Upload a new revision to "<title>"? / Upload revision; Abandon|Restore change "<title>"?; Mark "<title>" ready for review? | as work in progress?; Rebase "<title>" onto <ref>? / Revert "<title>" as a new change? / Cherry-pick "<title>" onto <ref>?

Triggers end with an ellipsis: Cancel queue entry…, Authorize merge automation…, Submit change…, Submit stack in order…, Prepare and submit next…, Apply selected suggestions…, Publish review…, Delete draft…, Upload revision…, Abandon/Restore change…, Mark … …, Rebase…/Revert…/Cherry-pick… (label follows the operation select).
Ordered-stack dialog titled 'Submit stack for "<title>" in order'; its list shows state pills and marks the selected change.

findings: Cards nested inside cards (drafts, publish, submission receipt).
Leading/trailing edge bars as selection markers: current file row, selected line number, current revision/stack item.
Hunk headers used the info tone as decoration; open non-blocking and resolved thread links used warning/success fills.
Notices used a coloured leading bar.
'Mark reviewed'/'Reviewed' swapped labels instead of showing a persistent pressed state.
File-list focus rings were clipped by the scrolling list.
Verbose headings repeated context ('Canonical CI for the selected exact revision', 'Apply published suggestions as a new immutable revision', …); 'Request review / add CC' and 'Subscribe me' labels.
Upload revision accepted an empty commit into its confirmation.
fixes: Nested sections are hairline subsections; grid-child buttons no longer stretch.
Selection uses the item's own fill and weight; forced-colors uses an outline.
Hunk headers muted; thread links neutral, warning only when unresolved and blocking (data-blocking).
Notices keep a single uniform border.
'Reviewed' is an aria-pressed toggle named 'Reviewed: <file>' with an icon whose state is visible.
File-list controls draw focus inside their own frame.

Headings: Canonical CI, Published suggestions, Discussion and drafts, Subscription and delivery, Identities and revisions, My drafts, Publish review; 'Request review'/'Add CC' follows the role select; Subscribe/Unsubscribe; select options sentence case.
Upload revision requires a commit before confirmation.

metrics.fixture_confirmations: dequeue, publish, delete draft, upload, abandon, WIP, submit (candidate variant), stack: titles and buttons as above, Escape restores focus to the trigger
